title.suggested: Tom Allen Umpires Boxing at Union Club Athletic Sports

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that about 4,000 people attended the Union Club athletic sports, where Tom Allen and Tom Kelly umpired the boxing and drew an ovation when they put on the mittens.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, July 5, 1884.

facts.fact: Allen and Tom Kelly served as umpires for the boxing contests at the Union Club athletic sports, attended by about 4,000, at the Union Base Ball Park, St. Louis
places: Union Base Ball Park, St. Louis

facts.fact: Allen and Tom Kelly received an ovation when they put on the mittens to spar at the Union Club athletic sports
places: Union Base Ball Park, St. Louis
